pages.title: Turbomolecular Vacuum Pump
pages.text: A pump whose rotor spins so fast that its blades knock gas molecules out of the chamber one by one. It whines at a pitch just below hearing. Ultra-high vacuum starts here. The rotor blades are angled like a jet turbine, and they spin faster than the eye can follow.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Mechanical pumps stop at a rough vacuum. A turbomolecular rotor, driven by a superconducting coil on neutronium and spacetime casing, kicked out the remaining molecules.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Cryogenics.
